failureReason: The model attempted to optimize the PPR shell by creating Suspense boundaries, but created incorrect implementations. Most runs created only 1 Suspense boundary wrapping all components together, when the test requires at least 3 separate boundaries with each of CardStats, RevenueChart, and LatestInvoices in its own Suspense boundary. The attempts that did create 3 boundaries renamed the components, breaking the test expectations.
